title: Study on Sodium Taxes in Countries with Such Measures and Potential Recommendations for Singapore
what_it_is: Study on Sodium Taxes in Countries with Such Measures and Potential Recommendations for Singapore

sections.label: Hungary tax on unhealthy food
sections.summary: Hungary taxes food items with unhealthy levels of salt and sugar, a practice Singapore does not intend to emulate.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Hungary went further, as beyond identifying food items which have unhealthy levels of salt and sugar, it imposes a tax on it.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: These are useful practices for us to learn from, but we do not intend to emulate any of these systems.

sections.label: HPB grant for lower-sodium ingredients
sections.summary: HPB gives grant support to salt and sauce suppliers through HIDS, with 15 major manufacturers and food operators committed.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Today, HPB offers grant support to salt and sauce suppliers to reformulate their products, through the Healthier Ingredient Development Scheme (HIDS).

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Today, the wholesale price of most lower-sodium salt, sauces and seasonings supplied to food operators are comparable to that of regular versions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To date, HPB has garnered the commitment of 15 major manufacturers and food operators, representing over 30% of the retail market for sauces and seasonings and 10% of the F&B market share, to increase the variety and demand of lower-sodium ingredients.

sections.label: Lower-sodium product prices and users
sections.summary: The grant has reduced wholesale prices of low-sodium salt and sauces, with 250 hawkers and about 150 caterers using them.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: With this grant, the wholesale prices of low-sodium salt, low-sodium sauces have actually reduced.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Actually, all of the low-sodium salt is comparable now with the regular salt and half of the low-sodium sauces supplied in the market are comparable to the prices of the regular products.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And now, we are still working on how we can enhance existing schemes further so that we can narrow this price differential even further especially for the low-sodium sauces as compared to the regular sauces.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: That includes  250 hawkers, coffeeshops and food courts island-wide, as well as about 150 caterers that are already using the lower-sodium products.

sections.label: Reviewing market for lower-sodium effort
sections.summary: Singapore will look at the market to see how the lower-sodium effort can be done better, as with lower sugar.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: As how we had approached it with the lower sugar effort, I think we are going to look at the market and see how we can do this better.
